boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: A powerful kinetic shield forms around #target#.
entries.target: #target#四周形成了强大的念力护盾。

entries.source:
A wave of natural energies flow around you in a radius of %d.  All creatures in the area will be affected by the Healing Nexus effect for %d turns.
		On you, this effect causes each heal received to restore %d equilibrium and be %d%% effective.
		On other creatures, all healing is intercepted and redirected to you at %d%% efficiency.
		Only direct healing (not normal regeneration) is affected.
entries.target:
一股自然能量在你周围半径 %d 范围内涌动，使范围内所有生物获得治疗转移效果，持续 %d 回合。
		对你而言，每次受到治疗会恢复 %d 点失衡值，治疗效果为 %d%%。
		对其他生物而言，所有治疗都会被截取，并以 %d%% 的效率转移给你。
		只有直接治疗会受影响，普通生命回复不受影响。

entries.source: #VIOLET#You have found Kyless. You must destroy him.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你找到了克里斯，你必须杀死他。

entries.source:
Imprisons all sleeping targets within range in their dream state, effectively extending sleeping effects for as long as Dream Prison is maintainted.
		This powerful effect constantly drains %0.2f%% of your maximum Psi (excluding this talent) per turn, and is considered a psionic channel; as such it will break if you move.
		(Note that sleeping effects that happen each turn, such as Nightmare's damage and Sleep's contagion, will cease to function for the duration of the effect.)
entries.target:
将范围内所有睡眠状态的目标囚禁在梦境牢笼里，有效地延长他们的睡眠效果，这个强大的技能每回合会持续消耗 %0.2f%% 最大灵能值（本技能除外），并且运用了灵能通道，所以当你移动时会中断此技能。
		注意：每回合可产生的睡眠附加状态，如梦魇的伤害和入梦的传染效果，将在此效果持续过程中失效。

entries.source: What is the Way, and what are you?
entries.target: 维网是什么，你是什么种族？

entries.source:
#GOLD#Telepathy#LAST#
Allows you to sense creatures of the given type(s) even if they are not currently in your line of sight.
entries.target:
#GOLD#心灵感应#LAST#
能让你心灵感应到指定类型的生物，哪怕它不在你的视线范围内。

entries.source: This ancient, weathered lantern glows with a pale blue light emanating from several ghostly forms trapped within.  The metal is icy cold to the touch.
entries.target: 这个古老、风化的灯笼放射出淡蓝色的光芒，光芒来自被困在其中的几个幽灵形体。它的金属表面摸上去像冰一样冷。

entries.source: a letter to Filio from the Master
They use the schools of Phantasm, Temporal, Divination and Conveyance magic to enhance their arts.
entries.target: 他们使用幻觉、时间、预知和传送技能来增强他们的能力。

entries.source:
Here's a list of the creature bits I need. Good luck with the murdering!

Oh, and one other last thing... if you have the time for another errand, though I've got no reward on this one.
entries.target:
这是我需要的生物部件清单。祝你杀得顺利！

哦，对了，最后还有另外一件事……另外还有一件差事不知道你感不感兴趣，不过这件事可没有报酬的。

entries.source:
Your melee and ranged attacks inflict distracting wounds that reduce the target’s critical strike multiplier by %d%% for 5 turns. 
In addition, your attacks have a %d%% chance to inflict a painful wound that causes them to forget a random talent for %d turns.  The last effect cannot occur more than once per turn per target.
entries.target:
你的近战和远程攻击制造的伤口会使敌人分心，使目标的暴击系数减少 %d%%，持续 5 回合。
		此外，你的攻击还有 %d%% 的几率造成痛苦的创伤，使敌人随机遗忘一项技能，持续 %d 回合。这一效果每回合最多只能触发一次。

entries.source: Got to level 200 of the infinite dungeon.
Try to confuse the target's mind for %d (power %d%%) turns.
entries.target: 试图使目标混乱 %d 回合 (强度 %d%%)。

entries.source:
You see a female human lying unconscious on a black altar, twisted sigils scored into her naked flesh.
Around her are several figures in dark robes.

As they notice you one calls out 'Intruder! Protect the seed of Kryl-Feijan!'
entries.target:
你看见一名人类女子赤身裸体地昏倒在黑色祭坛上，扭曲的符印深深刻入她的肌肤。
她身旁站着数名黑袍人。

他们一发现你，其中一人便大喊：“入侵者！保护克里尔·费扬之种！”

entries.source:
I have stared in the mouths of crimson wyrms
And felt the claws of drakes so sleek
But through deserts dry and sandy storms
There is something else I seek

In the trail of giant worms I walk
Through tunnels of sand below
Of arcane tools let there be no talk
It's on the wyrmic path I go!
entries.target:
我曾凝视赤红巨龙的巨口深处
也曾领教矫健幼龙利爪
可穿过干旱荒漠与沙暴
我所追寻的另有其物

我循着巨型沙虫的踪迹
穿行在地下沙土隧道
休要再提那些奥术器具
我走的是龙战士之道！

entries.source: %s grasps %s %s and has a sudden vision!
The targeted phase door fizzles and works randomly!
entries.target: 相位之门定位失败了，变为随机传送！

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[sacrifice yourself to bring forth your patron to Eyal!]
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[牺牲自己，让遥远太阳降临埃亚尔世界！]

entries.source: You cannot use Precision without dual wielding!
entries.target: 你只有在双持状态下才能使用这个技能！

entries.source: The target has been dominated.  It is unable to move and has lost %d armor and %d defense. Attacks from %s gain %d%% damage penetration.
entries.target: 目标已被支配，无法移动，并失去 %d 点护甲和 %d 点闪避。来自 %s 的攻击获得 %d%% 抗性穿透。

entries.source: Use Yiilkgur's teleporter to teleport to the ground.
entries.target: 使用伊克格的传送阵传送回地面。

entries.source: You can literaly feel the mental energies emitted by this yeek.
entries.target: 你可以感受到这名夺心魔周围的能量。

entries.source: You have a noble spirit, my lady.
entries.target: 女士，您的精神令人钦佩。

entries.source: afflicts the target with a poison dealing 20 damage per turn and causing actions to fail 20% of the time for 6 turns
entries.target: 使目标中毒，每回合造成20伤害，使用技能有20%几率失败，持续6回合。

entries.source: A vile poison drips from the tips of these arrows.
entries.target: 箭矢的尖端滴落着剧毒。

entries.source: Acid oozes all over this small demon's skin.  Beware, they tend to hunt in packs.
entries.target: 酸液从这只小恶魔的身体上渗出。当心，它们喜欢群体行动。

entries.source:
Every army of undead minions needs its spearhead. To that end you combine 3 skeleton minions into a bone giant of level %d.
		The minions used are selected from the weakest first, and a Lord of Skulls will never be used. 
		At level 3 an eternal bone giant is created instead.
		At level 6 a heavy bone giant is created instead.
		Only one bone giant may be active, and casting this spell while one already exists will destroy it and create a new one.
entries.target:
任何亡灵军队需要领袖。为此，你将 3 个骷髅随从合成成一个等级为 %d 的骨巨人。
		优先选择最弱的不死随从，且不会使用骷髅王作为合成材料。
		在等级 3 时，会改为制造 1 个永恒骨巨人。
		在等级 6 时，会改为制造 1 个重型骨巨人。
		任何时候最多只能有一个骨巨人，如果你在有骨巨人的时候使用这一技能，会摧毁原有的骨巨人，并用新的骨巨人取代它。
通用 精神反击伤害

entries.source: Linked yourself in the in-game chat.
entries.target: 将自己的数据链接到聊天框。
启动防御系统，瞄准目标，**启动摧毁命令**！

entries.source: All your damage is converted and split into light and darkness.
entries.target: 你造成的所有伤害被转化均分为光系和暗影伤害。

entries.source:
It simply costs more to increase scores that are in higher tiers.

For each tier, here's the cost of increasing your score by one:

#B4B4B4#Tier 1#WHITE#: 1 point
#FFFFFF#Tier 2#WHITE#: 2 points
#00FF80#Tier 3#WHITE#: 3 points
#0080FF#Tier 4#WHITE#: 4 points
#8d55ff#Tier 5#WHITE#: 5 points
entries.target:
其实很简单，层级越高，你提高属性越困难。

对于每个层级，每提高1点属性需要的点数如下：

#B4B4B4#层级 1#WHITE#：1 点
#FFFFFF#层级 2#WHITE#：2 点
#00FF80#层级 3#WHITE#：3 点
#0080FF#层级 4#WHITE#：4 点
#8d55ff#层级 5#WHITE#：5 点

entries.source: A hand may clap alone if it returns to clap itself. Search for the power in the paradox.
entries.target: 如果一只手能拍到过去的自己，那么就可以单手鼓掌。在时空悖论中寻求力量吧。

entries.source: #YELLOW#You killed %d enemies in a single turn! The public is excited!
entries.target: #YELLOW#你在一回合内干掉了%d个敌人！观众们很兴奋！

entries.source: Hate-powered abilities that don't belong anywhere else.
entries.target: 不适于其他地方的仇恨之力。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +10% fire damage, -10% fire resistance, -10% armour, -2 sight range.
entries.target: 范围效果：+10% 火焰伤害，-10% 火焰抗性，-10% 护甲值，-2 可视范围。

entries.source: Wrap a psionic energy field around your weapons, increasing their armour penentration by %d and allowing you to siphon excess energy from each weapon hit you land, gaining %0.1f psi per hit.
entries.target: 用灵能强化武器，获得 %d 护甲穿透，同时吸取每次武器攻击中剩余的能量，每次武器命中时获得 %0.1f 点灵能值。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 魔法，+0 意志，+1 灵巧
